drown.en: He was drowning in debt, and was at risk of having to declare personal bankruptcy.
drown.zh: 他债台高筑，面临着不得不宣布个人破产的风险。

drown.en: If we catch them in the toilet, we’ll drown them there.”
drown.zh: 如果我们把他们在厕所里抓到，我们就会把他们淹死在那里。”

drown.en: Stonehouse was presumed drowned, or even eaten by sharks, after his clothes were found neatly folded on a Miami beach.
drown.zh: 在迈阿密海滩上发现了 Stonehouse 整齐叠放的衣服后，人们推测他溺水身亡，甚至可能被鲨鱼吃掉了。

drown.en: The country was drowning in debt, and George was now responsible for a vast, difficult-to-govern empire across the Atlantic.
drown.zh: 国家深陷债务泥潭，而 George 现在要为一个庞大且难以治理的大西洋彼岸帝国负责。

drown.en: Buildings get destroyed, people can drown.
drown.zh: 建筑物被毁，人们可能会溺水。

drug.en: I think the word sounds negative because it is associated with drug cartels.
drug.zh: 我认为这个词听起来很负面，因为它与贩毒集团（drug cartels）联系在一起。

drug.en: OK then. For radio listener Lynne Massey-Davis, weight loss drugs have been life-changing.
drug.zh: 那好吧。对于电台听众 Lynne Massey-Davis 来说，减肥药改变了她的生活。

drug.en: He published an article titled, “The Underground Website Where You Can Buy Any Drug Imaginable”.
drug.zh: 他发表了一篇题为《在这个地下网站，你可以买到任何能想象到的毒品》的文章。

drug.en: Yes. Weight loss drugs like Ozempic and Mounjaro have been a hot topic this year.
drug.zh: 是的。像 Ozempic 和 Mounjaro 这样的减肥药是今年的热门话题。

drug.en: His mother struggled deeply with drug addiction, both heroin and prescription opioids.
drug.zh: 他的母亲饱受毒瘾困扰，既有海洛因，也有处方阿片类药物。

dreadful.en: But the critics, of course, say that this crosses an ethical line, that it sets a dreadful example because it risks normalising doping.
dreadful.zh: 但批评者当然表示，这越过了道德底线，树立了一个可怕的榜样，因为它有使兴奋剂常规化的风险。

dream.en: And when international tourists dream of visiting Brazil, Rio is usually their first destination.
dream.zh: 当国际游客梦想游览巴西时，里约通常是他们的第一目的地。

dream.en: But today, many people in the US are questioning whether that dream still exists.
dream.zh: 但如今，许多美国人正在质疑这个梦想是否依然存在。

dream.en: And to be fair, the dream is closer to reality than it was in 2022.
dream.zh: 公平地说，这个梦想比 2022 年时更接近现实了。

dream.en: Especially for people from the UK, Australia is often considered a dream place to live.
dream.zh: 特别是对英国人来说，澳大利亚通常被认为是一个理想的居住地。

dream.en: So, what exactly is the American Dream? Where did the idea come from?
dream.zh: 那么，究竟什么是美国梦？这个理念从何而来？

drought.en: What’s more, water is also needed to grow food and that’s getting harder due to droughts which are increasing with climate change.
drought.zh: 不仅如此，种植农作物也需要水，而随着气候变化导致的干旱日益加剧，这件事变得越来越难。

drought.en: But rice is a very ‘thirsty’ crop which needs lots of water to grow, and this is becoming a problem because of droughts and flooding caused by climate change.
drought.zh: 但水稻是一种非常“耗水”的作物，生长需要大量的水，而由于气候变化导致的干旱和洪水，这正成为一个问题。

drought.en: One of the hottest places on Earth, Yuma has been experiencing its worst drought in 500 years, forcing farmers to pump water from rivers to grow their date palm trees.
drought.zh: 尤马是地球上最炎热的地方之一，正经历着500年来最严重的干旱，迫使农民从河流中抽水来种植枣椰树。

drought.en: According to the UK government's recent report, there are many issues affecting Britain's food supply: geopolitical conflicts like those in Ukraine and Iran, droughts and water shortages, loss of biodiversity caused by climate change... the list goes on and on.
drought.zh: 根据英国政府最近的报告，影响英国食物供应的问题有很多：比如乌克兰和伊朗的地缘政治冲突、干旱和水资源短缺、气候变化导致的生物多样性丧失……这样的例子不胜枚举。

drift.en: A drifting gambler with a chequered past became the man who tamed the West.
drift.zh: 一个有着不光彩过去、四处漂泊的赌徒，就此变成了驯服西部的那个人。

drift.en: I think it's a novelty for now and people will drift away from it.
drift.zh: 我认为这目前只是一种新鲜感，人们会逐渐远离它。

drift.en: No longer would festivals and planting seasons drift aimlessly through the year.
drift.zh: 节日和播种季节将不再漫无目的地在一年中漂移。

drift.en: By the 16th century, the calendar had drifted out of alignment with the seasons once again.
drift.zh: 到了 16 世纪，日历再次与季节失去了同步。

drift.en: It’s easy to drift away from what had been helping you work.
drift.zh: 你很容易偏离那些曾经帮助你不断进步的方法。

drop.en: Rishi Sunak has seen his popularity drop further and further as time has passed.
drop.zh: 随着时间的推移，Rishi Sunak 的支持率不断下滑。

drop.en: People who invested in overvalued AI companies could see their investments drop sharply in value.
drop.zh: 投资于被高估的AI公司的投资者会看到他们的投资价值急剧下降。

drop.en: Adam's jaw dropped – an idiom for when someone looks shocked and surprised.
drop.zh: 亚当的下巴掉了——这是一个用来形容某人看起来震惊和惊讶的习语。

drop.en: 0.03 grams of CO2 is practically nothing, and 0.26 millilitres is five drops of water.
drop.zh: 0.03 克的二氧化碳几乎等于没有，而 0.26 毫升就是五滴水。

drop.en: Argos notices the beggar walking past, drops his ears, lifts his head and wags his tail.
drop.zh: 阿耳戈斯注意到乞丐从旁走过，它垂下耳朵，抬起头，摇了摇尾巴。

drill.en: And just in case you need a reminder, Roman soldiers were incredibly well- drilled and well-trained.
drill.zh: 为了以防你需要提醒，罗马士兵一向训练有素、纪律严明。

drill.en: And if we drill down even further the differences are even greater.
drill.zh: 如果进一步细分对比，差异还会更大。

drill.en: So, someone who has really strong genetics to protect them from hearing, but spends their life on a pneumatic drill, may have a much faster decline than someone on the other side.
drill.zh: 因此，某人拥有非常强大的基因来保护他们的听力，但一辈子都在用风镐，其听力衰退的速度可能会比其他人快得多。

drill.en: Though they were originally supporting troops, many of them had been trained and equipped in the Roman style, with long spears, oval shields, and discipline drilled into them by years of warfare.
drill.zh: 虽然他们最初只是支援部队，但其中许多人已经接受了罗马风格的训练和装备，配备长矛、椭圆形盾牌，并且经过多年战事的洗礼，纪律严明。

drain.en: So, if you feel drained or exhausted at home, it could be your clutter.
drain.zh: 所以，如果你在家感到筋疲力尽，那可能是因为你的杂物。

drain.en: The problem with sandy soil is that it drains water.
drain.zh: 沙质土壤的问题在于它会排水。

drain.en: If you drain something, you remove the liquid from it.
drain.zh: 如果你把什么东西里的液体排干，你就是去除了里面的液体。

drain.en: This was, in many ways, a continuation of his earlier pledge to “drain the swamp”, but now it seemed less politically-motivated, more about using taxpayer money more efficiently and for American interests rather than targeting career politicians.
drain.zh: 从许多方面来看，这是他早期“清淤泥”承诺的延续，但现在它看起来更少一些政治动机，更多的是关于如何更高效地利用纳税人的钱服务于美国利益，而不是针对职业政客。

drawer.en: The answer is to go slow, as she explains here to BBC Radio 4's Woman's Hour: You have to do decluttering slowly but surely: one drawer, one cupboard at a time.
drawer.zh: 答案是慢慢来，正如她在这里向BBC广播四台的《女性时间》解释的那样：你必须稳扎稳打地进行断舍离：一次一个抽屉，一次一个橱柜。

dramatic.en: They used to host mock battles, executions, and dramatic performances inside the Colosseum.
dramatic.zh: 他们过去常常在斗兽场内举办模拟海战、处决和戏剧表演。

dramatic.en: Now, back to Dwight Eisenhower. His words marked a dramatic turning point.
dramatic.zh: 言归正传，回到 Dwight Eisenhower。他的话标志着一个戏剧性的转折点。

dramatic.en: This dramatic event revealed to Darwin that the earth is not static.
dramatic.zh: 这一戏剧性的事件向Darwin揭示了地球并不是静止的。

dramatic.en: Throughout the campaign, voters were repeatedly shown bold and dramatic claims.
dramatic.zh: 在整个竞选期间，选民们不断看到大胆且戏剧性的主张。

dramatic.en: And the pressure to get more views and earn more money encourages dramatic headlines and careless reporting.
dramatic.zh: 获取更多点击量和赚取更多资金的压力助长了戏剧化的标题和草率的报道。

drum.en: I couldn't give you a word, but you definitely march to your own drum.
drum.zh: 我找不出一个词来形容你，但你绝对是走自己的路。

drum.en: If you march to your own drum, you do things in your own unique way, regardless of how other people do them.
drum.zh: 如果你“march to your own drum”（我行我素），你就会以自己独特的方式做事，不管别人怎么做。

drum.en: Within 30 seconds of hearing a brand-new song, he can jump in and play a drum part that fits perfectly, and often sounds even better than the original.
drum.zh: 在听到一首全新歌曲的 30 秒内，他就可以切入并演奏一段完美契合的鼓点，而且通常听起来比原版还要好。

drum.en: Some commentators would later claim that the Otto Warmbier case was used by Trump to drum up anti-North Korean sentiment in preparation for a potential military strike.
drum.zh: 后来有评论人士声称，特朗普利用了奥托·瓦姆比尔一案来煽动反朝鲜情绪，为一场可能的军事打击做铺垫。

drum.en: One of their most impressive challenges is this: they play a famous song without the drum track, and ask the drummer to add their own version without ever hearing the original.
drum.zh: 他们最令人印象深刻的挑战之一是：他们在没有鼓点音轨的情况下播放一首名曲，并要求鼓手在从未听过原版的情况下加入他们自己的版本。

drawing.en: What began in Victorian drawing rooms spread across the industrialised world throughout the 20th century.
drawing.zh: 始于维多利亚时代客厅的这股风潮，在整个20世纪传遍了整个工业化世界。

drawing.en: Her hit song, Cruel Summer, created a peak - the highest point - in the graph which James's machine was drawing.
drawing.zh: 她的热门歌曲《Cruel Summer》在James的机器正在绘制的图表中创造了一个峰值——最高点。

drawing.en: He learned painting, drawing, sculpture, mechanics, and basic engineering.
drawing.zh: 他学习了绘画、素描、雕塑、机械学和基础工程学。

drawing.en: This was unusual at the time, but it allowed him to produce incredibly detailed and accurate drawings of the human body.
drawing.zh: 这在当时很不寻常，但这使他能够绘制出极其详细且准确的人体图纸。

drunk.en: He was also an awful drunk and was seen as a liability.
drunk.zh: 他也是个臭名昭著的酒鬼，被视为一种累赘。

drunk.en: He had been, the committee found, habitually drunk.
drunk.zh: 调查委员会发现，他经常酗酒。

drunk.en: To many Russians, especially compared to the permanently drunk and unreliable Yeltsin, he seemed like the strong leader the country desperately needed.
drunk.zh: 对于许多俄罗斯人来说，尤其是与那个终日酗酒、靠不住的叶利钦相比，他似乎正是国家急需的强力领袖。

drunk.en: They were unpredictable, loud, often drunk and at times undisciplined, but they could bring raw power and overwhelming force when unleashed in a charge.
drunk.zh: 他们变幻莫测、吵闹喧哗、常常喝得酩酊大醉有时甚至缺乏纪律，但在发起冲锋时，他们能爆发出原始的力量和排山倒海的冲击力。

drunk.en: Sure, it was New Year’s Eve, and everyone had had a few drinks, but there was no indication that he was particularly drunk or disorderly, nobody remembered him causing any problems.
drunk.zh: 没错，那天是除夕夜，大家都喝了点酒，但没有迹象表明他特别醉或者行为失控，也没有人记得他惹出过什么麻烦。

drag.en: In his eyes, it was Rome that had dragged Carthage into a ruinous war.
drag.zh: 在他看来，正是罗马把迦太基拖入了这场毁灭性的战争。

drag.en: So, many of them preferred to drag out conflicts because it meant longer contracts and more money.
drag.zh: 因此，他们中的许多人更愿意拖延冲突，因为这意味着更长的合同和更多的钱。

drag.en: Some Moai weigh more than 70 tons. One theory suggests that they were laid flat and dragged on wooden sleds.
drag.zh: 有些 Moai 的重量超过70吨。有一种理论认为，它们是被放倒并用木质雪橇拖拽的。

drag.en: And in many versions, there is the devil himself, who arrives at the end to drag Mr Punch off to hell.
drag.zh: 在许多版本中，甚至还有魔鬼本人，他在最后登场，把 Mr Punch 拖进地狱。

drag.en: It’s the fact that business is harder, foreign companies don't want to invest in the country; the corruption drags everything down.
drag.zh: 而是做生意变得更加困难，外国公司不想在这个国家投资；腐败拖累了一切。

draft.en: He even wrote a draft letter of abdication, where he would step down from the throne, before deciding to stay.
draft.zh: 他甚至写了一份退位诏书草稿，打算从王位上退下来，但最终决定留下来。

draft.en: They found a wealth of evidence, including four fully constructed and ready-to-mail bombs, and the original, handwritten draft of the 35,000-word manifesto.
draft.zh: 他们发现了丰富的证据，包括四枚完全组装好、准备邮寄的炸弹，以及那份 35,000 字宣言的原始手写草稿。

draft.en: Anyone listening to the speech could clearly understand that these weren’t his words; someone with good but imperfect English had drafted the statement.
draft.zh: 任何听过这段发言的人都能清楚地看出，这些不是他自己的话；这份声明是由一个英语水平不错、但并非完美的人起草的。

draft.en: If you spend too much time down internet rabbit holes, you’ll find accusations of the Freemasons’ involvement in historical events like the drafting of the U.S.
draft.zh: 如果你花太多时间泡在互联网的阴暗角落里，你会发现对共济会参与历史事件的种种指控，比如起草美国宪法。

draft.en: Now, when I've finished the draft of an episode, I’ll typically wait at least 24 hours, preferably more like two or three days, and then I’ll return to the script.
draft.zh: 当我完成一期节目的草稿后，我通常会等待至少 24 小时，最好是两三天，然后再回过头来看脚本。

dragon.en: And in part three, it’ll be the fire-breathing, mythical world of dragons.
dragon.zh: 而在第三部分中，将是喷火的神话世界——龙。

dragon.en: The cat. And in part three it’ll be the history of an animal that didn’t exist at all: the dragon.
dragon.zh: 猫。而在第三部分中，我们将探讨一种根本不存在的动物的历史：龙。

dread.en: But the true identity of Dread Pirate Roberts was still a mystery.
dread.zh: 但 Dread Pirate Roberts 的真实身份仍然是一个谜。

dread.en: Dread Pirate Roberts wasn’t a person; it was a title.
dread.zh: Dread Pirate Roberts 不是一个人，而是一个头衔。

drama.en: In the hit political drama, House of Cards, the Machiavellian protagonist, Frank Underwood, hatches a plot to become President.
drama.zh: 在热门政治剧《纸牌屋》中，善于权谋的主角弗兰克·安德伍德密谋成为总统。

drama.en: Students are examined in mathematics, science, history, geography, English, other languages, even examined in art and drama and music.
drama.zh: 学生要接受数学、科学、历史、地理、英语、其他语言的考核，甚至还要考美术、戏剧和音乐。

drama.en: He has often said that he became interested in politics as a teenager after watching a BBC drama called Boys from the Blackstuff, which focused on unemployment and poverty in Liverpool during the 1980s.
drama.zh: 他经常说，自己在十几岁时看了BBC一部名为《黑领带男孩》（Boys from the Blackstuff）的电视剧后对政治产生了兴趣，该剧聚焦于20世纪80年代利物浦的失业和贫困问题。

drainage.en: The Spanish had destroyed the Aztec drainage system and filled in the Aztec canals.
drainage.zh: 西班牙人摧毁了阿兹特克的排水系统，并填平了阿兹特克的运河。

drainage.en: They had complex drainage and sewage systems that ran underneath the streets.
drainage.zh: 它们拥有在街道下方运行的复杂的排水和排污系统。

drainage.en: And they had constructed a unique drainage system that worked amazingly well for hundreds of years.
drainage.zh: 他们构建了一个独特的排水系统，在几百年里运作得好得出奇。
